## Upstream synchronization (when applicable)

- [ ] Full upstream merge; exceptions are explained, with replacement behavior.
- [ ] Actual source commit/version recorded in tools/upstream/baseline.json.
- [ ] Every release item has firmware, classic-tab and Valet-tab disposition in coverage.json.
- [ ] Both tabs and physical-key behavior reviewed; prototype version does not imply hardware verification.
- [ ] Host regressions, browser regressions and full ESP-IDF build pass.
- [ ] App size/free space recorded; no unreviewed partition, resource, touch-firmware or cloud-credential changes.
- [ ] Hardware tests or remaining limitations stated; gateway pin unchanged unless explicitly reviewed.
